definitions.explanation: To swim in various directions; to swim about an area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The fish are swimming around in the tank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦イルカ→イルカ：04313_iruka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}った。

notes:
A compound verb meaning to swim around freely or in various directions.

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from ⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ (to swim) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around). The ～⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ pattern indicates movement in various directions or throughout an area.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- The subject (fish, person, etc.) moves freely through water

ASPECT (ている):
{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing action of swimming around, emphasizing continuous movement in multiple directions.

SIMILAR ～{回|まわ}る COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧: to run around
- ⟦{歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る→歩き回る：04605_arukimawaru⟧: to walk around
- ⟦{飛|と}び{回|まわ}る→飛び回る：04610_tobimawaru⟧: to fly around
- ⟦{動|うご}き{回|まわ}る→動き回る：04612_ugokimawaru⟧: to move around
